main_text.head: JOHANNIS BUXTORFII JUN. LEXICON CHALDAICUM ET SYRIACUM.
א
main_text.p: אויר Syr. Aer, Græc. Ἀήρ, 1.ad Cor.9.26. & 14. 9. 1.ad Thess.4.17. [illegible, ~8 letters] Princeps potestatis aeris, ad Eph.2.2. Chaldæi dicunt, אויר.
אב Chald. Abh, nomen mensis, qui Julio nostro respondet, Esth.3.7. in Targ.sec.
אבה Ch. Voluit, Acquievit, Desideravit, ut Hebraicè, & sic quoq; fere semper addità negatione; לא אבא Non voluit, Noluit.

אבא Ch. & Syr. Pater, à Benevolentia sic dictus. Includit quoque Avum, Proavum, & pluraliter quosvis Majores. Pro Avo reperies Exod.2.18. Plural. אבהתא, אבהן, & [illegible, ~4 letters] Syr. Patres, Majores. Hinc Cœnobiarcha dicitur Abbas, quasi Pater cœnobii: [illegible, ~6 letters] Patriarcha, Act.2.29.
[illegible, ~5 letters] Syr. Paternitas, Paterna familia, Cognatio, ad Ephes.3. v.15. Græc: πατριά.

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are reproduced from a small, low-resolution scan; the Syriac forms are not legible enough to copy and are marked illegible. The Hebrew forms are approximate and may need checking. A faint show-through of the title from the other side is ignored.
